root_cause: Fortress atlas pipeline downscaled Dante's high-res painterly sheet crops with nearest-neighbor at SCALE=0.40 (tools/ft_tx_cut.py / ft_tx_round2.py), after a hard alpha threshold that destroyed soft edges. Runtime then forced NEAREST (pixelArt + Fortress setFilter) and the boss used setScale(1.35), a non-integer scale on NEAREST textures. Detail dies at atlas build; runtime chewing makes it worse. Edge recolor/despeckle increased stair-steps.

not_primarily_motion.note: Camera uses HiRes 1/HI quantization; player has subpixel x. Visual choppiness is texture sampling, not mainly frame pacing. Swiftshader FPS is low; expect ~60 on real GPU.

fix.atlas: Lanczos + premultiplied alpha, SCALE=0.48, soft alpha edges
fix.runtime_filter: LINEAR for all ft_ textures in Fortress
